reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse flow system, water depth is now more responsive and accurate, allowing for seamless edits to the landscape. No more freezing frames when turning on a well! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Mechanics Update
steam.body: We're excited to announce improvements to the water mechanics in Provincia! The new native sparse flow system allows water depth to react more accurately to terrain changes, eliminating freezing frames when activating wells. Dive into the details of this update and see how it enhances your city-building experience! Read more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
